lineages.name: Micro / Macro
lineages.summary: A long-standing competitive-game vocabulary that distinguishes local execution and unit control from broader economic and strategic control.
simplifies: psychological and social dimensions of play

provenance.claim: A dated TeamLiquid community guide uses Micro and Macro as teachable StarCraft skill categories.

connections.claim: Micro and Macro are documented community vocabularies that predate Surnex's later cross-genre synthesis.
connections.qualification: Earlier use is established; direct influence on Surnex and a definitive origin are not.

version_history.label: Earlier documented community use in a TeamLiquid StarCraft guide, dated 2009-11-02
Later cross-genre Micro, Meso and Macro synthesis documented in the Surnex corpus

lineages.name: Yomi / Reads
lineages.summary: A competitive vocabulary for anticipating an opponent, recognising layers of intention and acting on a read under uncertainty.

provenance.claim: Sirlin's Playing to Win documents Yomi as a vocabulary for reading and predicting an opponent.

connections.claim: Yomi offers an earlier vocabulary for prediction that helps interpret the knowledge and mind-games territory of the Surnex model.
connections.qualification: This is a conceptual comparison by the project author; no direct line of influence is claimed.

version_history.label: Earlier documented Yomi explanation in Playing to Win
Conceptual comparison with the middle layer of the Surnex framework

lineages.name: Surnex to Player Type
lineages.summary: A contemporary cross-genre Micro, Meso and Macro synthesis that was later remediated as an interactive site, making circulation and adaptation visible without proving a complete genealogy.
makes_visible: framework circulation from diagram to interface
simplifies: variation by role, rank, mode and patch
social, embodied and contextual dimensions of skill

provenance.claim: Surnex applies Micro, Meso and Macro categories across a set of competitive games in a cross-genre diagram.
Player Type explicitly builds from Surnex's original set and adds custom games and its own archetype labels.

connections.claim: Earlier Micro and Macro vocabulary provides a documented precedent to the later three-part synthesis.
connections.qualification: Chronology and vocabulary are documented; direct influence and definitive origin are not.

connections.claim: Yomi is conceptually adjacent to the framework's account of knowledge and mind games.
connections.qualification: This is an interpretive comparison, not evidence of direct influence.

version_history.label: Surnex cross-genre diagram documented in the Assessment 1 corpus
Player Type interactive adaptation documented by its methodology page
